summary: Hesai Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Hong Kong Exchange monthly return on movements in securities for October 2026, a routine foreign-private-issuer disclosure with a US-equivalent being an ordinary periodic share-capital update. Authorized and issued capital were unchanged: 215,990,888 Class A ordinary shares and 1,045,146,800 Class B WVR shares outstanding, zero treasury, with registered capital of USD 100,000 across both classes. The issuer confirms compliance with the 15% minimum public float threshold. No transaction, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is present; watch only for future option exercises or capital changes.
